mentions.name: DesktopDeck
mentions.description: A desktop app that bundles multiple applications into a "deck" and installs them all at once, supporting custom scripts, config files placed at specified paths, and silent non-interactive installs. Built on top of WinGet and Homebrew for Windows and Mac.
mentions.problem: Streamlines new machine setup, teammate onboarding, and sharing a standard dev environment across a team.
mentions.audience: Developers setting up new machines, teams onboarding teammates, and teams sharing a standardized dev environment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a desktop app that lets you bundle multiple apps into a "deck" and install them all at once. You can also add custom scripts, config files to specified paths, and it handles non-interactive installs silently. Built on top of WinGet/Homebrew for Windows & Mac.
Use cases: new machine setup, onboarding teammates, sharing a standard dev environment across a team.
